$comment: Own signatures in the same schema as data/fingerprints. Merged over the upstream definitions at load time (arrays are concatenated, objects merged). Found with the discoveryCandidates report in output/summary.json (signals no rule explained) and by inspecting the Shopify stores in the dataset. Entries with "$replace" swap those upstream fields for stricter patterns; these fix false positives found in the manual precision check (see README).

Shopify theme.description: The Shopify theme a store is built on, read from the theme schema Shopify prints into every storefront. The version field holds the theme name and its version.

Shop (Follow on Shop).description: Shopify's Shop app integration that lets customers follow the store in the Shop app.

Google & YouTube for Shopify.description: Google's Shopify sales channel app. It syncs products to Google Merchant Center and sends storefront events to Merchant Center analytics.

Google Search Console.description: Google's tool for monitoring a site in Google Search. Site owners prove ownership with a TXT record.

KnowBe4.description: Security awareness training and simulated phishing platform.

Sophos.description: Sophos security products (email, endpoint and firewall). Domains are verified with a TXT record.

Validity.description: Email deliverability and data quality platform (Everest, Return Path).

PeopleXD.description: HR, payroll and recruitment software by Access Group.
